name: How to summon a Demon
source:
Summon your very own demon together with Ember Witchcliff! 

Your decisions will lead you to one of 20 different Demons, each with unique abilities.

[From [url=https://psyckomeico.itch.io/how-to-summon-a-demon]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
与Ember Witchcliff一起召唤你自己的恶魔！

你的决定将引导你找到20种不同恶魔中的一种，每种都有独特的能力。

[来自[url=https://psyckomeico.itch.io/how-to-summon-a-demon]itch.io[/url]]
